form.name: Graduated Driver License Form (Behind the Wheel Verification)

title: Graduated Driver License Form

certification.title: BEHIND THE WHEEL VERIFICATION FORM
certification.text: ______ certify that the applicant Has completed a minimum of 50 hours of behind-the-wheel driving practice as required by section 32-6-7.2 of the Code of Alabama 1975.

signatures.label: Signature of Parent or Legal Guardian

certification.extra_text: PERMISSION TO DRIVE WITHOUT SUPERVISION: ______ consent to the licensure of {student_name} and granting permission for the applicant to drive without supervision as required by section 32-6-7.2 of the Code of Alabama 1975.

notes: The same page also carries 'PERMISSION TO DRIVE WITHOUT SUPERVISION' (signature + Name of Applicant) and a driver-education CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION box.
